conditionPrometheusQueryLanguage.query: (sum by (pod, namespace) (container_fs_usage_bytes{cluster="<CLUSTER_NAME>", namespace="<K8S_NAMESPACE>", container!="", container!="POD"}) / sum by (pod, namespace) (container_fs_limit_bytes{cluster="<CLUSTER_NAME>", namespace="<K8S_NAMESPACE>", container!="", container!="POD"})) * 100 > 80

documentation.content:
## GKE Disk Utilization Warning (80%)

Disk utilization in namespace (<K8S_NAMESPACE>) on GKE cluster (<CLUSTER_NAME>) has exceeded **80%** for **15 minutes**.
